agent.response:

# owner: platform-team
import falcon
import json

class HealthResource:
    def on_get(self, req, resp):
        resp.text = json.dumps({"status": "ok"})
        resp.content_type = falcon.MEDIA_JSON

app = falcon.App()
app.add_route('/health', HealthResource())
